cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to 10

gics_sector.description: One of 11 GICS sectors; the normalisation bucket

hq_state.description: HQ state, used to constrain entity matching

market_cap_usd.description: Market cap; bubble size on the 3D map

scope1_tco2e.description: Scope 1. EPA-measured (S15) and self-reported (S10) coexist by design -- the gap between them is the say-do signal.

scope2_market_tco2e.description: Scope 2, market-based. A renewable claim that moves this but NOT the location-based figure is an unbundled REC purchase -- flag, do not credit.

ghg_facility_count.description: Reporting facilities in GHGRP. Track YoY: a divestiture looks identical to an emissions cut. Movement excludes the company from trajectory scoring.

grid_intensity_kgco2e_per_mwh.description: eGRID subregion intensity for the company's facility footprint

waste_diverted_pct.description: Share of waste diverted from landfill

cogs_usd.description: Cost of goods sold; input efficiency numerator

revenue_usd.description: Revenue. Splits across 4+ XBRL tags -- the fallback chain lives in sources/s01_sec_xbrl/fields.py, not in caller code.

free_cash_flow_usd.description: CFO - capex. The affordability denominator: can they pay for what they promised.

clean_capex_usd.description: Low-carbon portion of capex, from Item 7 MD&A. Expect ~1/3 hit rate -- the low rate is itself a finding, report it.

green_revenue_share_pct.description: Revenue from low-carbon segments. The classification is OURS, not the company's -- per-segment rationale must be published alongside.

risk_hitword_density.description: Item 1A hitwords weighted by POSITION and proximity to intensifiers. Raw counts measure document length -- ship the text-vs-XBRL discrepancy, not the count. No negation handling: name that limit in the pitch.

risk_first_factor_topic.description: Topic of the FIRST risk factor. What comes first is what management fears.

y02_patent_share_pct.description: Y02 (climate-mitigation) share of recent filings. True zero for financials and services -- report as zero-with-explanation, never null.

lobbying_climate_flag.description: Lobbied on a climate-relevant issue code. A flag, not a score -- attribution via trade associations is messy.

has_climate_oversight_committee.description: Named board committee with explicit climate oversight

comp_tied_to_emissions_target.description: Executive comp linked to an emissions metric

has_clawback_policy.description: Clawback provision. WATCH NEGATION: 'we do not maintain a clawback policy' contains the keyword and means the opposite.

has_psu_plan.description: Performance share units in the LTI plan

penalty_total_usd.description: Penalties from COURT AND AGENCY RECORDS, not news sentiment. News-based controversy scores measure media volume, which tracks company size.
